items.text: Kansas City (final report + Sat update): OUT - RB Kenneth Walker III (groin, reported Fri; listed questionable then ruled out, rookie Emmett Johnson takes first-team work), RT Jaylon Moore (ankle), DT Peter Woods (neck), DT Omarr Norman-Lott (knee). QUESTIONABLE - CB Mansoor Delane (shoulder), RB Jaydn Ott (hamstring). IR - WR Tyquan Thornton, CB L'Jarius Sneed, LT Josh Simmons. Patrick Mahomes starts.
items.source: Yahoo Sports (NFL news live updates, Week 10, Nov 14)

items.text: Atlanta (final report): OUT - WR Zachariah Branch (hamstring). DOUBTFUL - LB Divine Deablo (forearm). QUESTIONABLE - DT Gervon Dexter Sr. (illness), DE James Pearce Jr. (back), LB Josh Woods (ankle). IR - RB Brian Robinson Jr., DE Samson Ebukam, DT Da'Shawn Hand. Michael Penix Jr. starts.
